dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Hello. I'm so sorry, but may I... ask you something?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Have you ever met a little creature with ears and a tail?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A little creature?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: If you meet a creature... I mean a girl who's about this tall, please let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: This girl's name is Sayu. She is a little ninja from the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission. She's very, very cute.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: But she doesn't like to work and hides away to take naps all the time. She said that she'll grow taller this way...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Sayu has an aptitude for ninjutsu, so she's very elusive. She can even be a bigger headache than Heizou...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: I really hope I can find her soon. Then I'll have some time to ask Lady Yae for the latest novels...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Heizou?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Ah, I was referring to a distant cousin of mine. Surname's Shikanoin, and the name's Heizou.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: He doesn't like to abide by the rules and always gets himself in trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: I figured he'd grow out of his rebellious phase... I didn't expect him to become a detective. Now I can't even find out where he is.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: As his elder cousin, I just want to take good care of him. But to do that, I need to find him first...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The latest novels, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Yeah! But it's not just the "latest" novel! It's the draft of a yet-to-be-published work!

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: You have probably heard of Yae Publishing House already, right? The owner of this publishing house is the Guuji Yae herself, our head shrine maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Ever since Lady Yae learned that I am a novel enthusiast, she would often offer me the drafts of Yae Publishing House novels to read.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Let me tell you a secret. When Lady Yae is acting as the boss of Yae Publishing House, she behaves very differently than she does as the Guuji. She's actually really kind and often asks me about my thoughts on these new novels.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Hehe, if my silly comments can help her out, that's nice, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ears and tail?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Yeah, I'm looking for this girl who has the ears and tail of a badger.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: But the ears and tail don't actually grow from her body — they're just part of her outfit.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Her name is Sayu. She is a little ninja from the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission. She always disappears to slack off if she gets a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Some say that the big tail on her outfit has lots of ninjutsu items hidden inside, which can help her hide... Alas, that's a big headache for anyone who is in charge of looking for her, like me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's with you and the Yashiro Commission?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Specifically, you're asking why a ninja from the Yashiro Commission would a shrine maiden to look after her, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Because the Yashiro Commission is in charge of the religious and ceremonial affairs as well as other cultural matters in Inazuma. Therefore, the shrine maidens of the Grand Narukami Shrine must also follow the orders of the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Though I suppose a ninja like Sayu who likes to slack off and needs a specific person to look after her is something of an exception...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Please help me look out for her while you are traveling around. Please!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Ah, you have never seen her... That's okay. Thank you anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Hello. I'm sorry, but... Sayu has disappeared again.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Please let me know if you see her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She's the same as always, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Yes. she doesn't like to work and hides away to take naps all the time. She said that she'll grow taller this way...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: I really hope I can find her soon. Then I'll have some time to ask Lady Yae for the latest novels...

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
